mechanism: Channel z-order: comb.py:448 routes the comb's main channels through field_channel(..., late=True), whose late water block is spliced after the plots (settlement/core.py:390, settlement/finish.py:706-753). Not every channel: comb.py:467 (the seam/run ditches) and hamletgen/sink.py:96 (the outfall drain) call field_channel without late=True, so their z-order rests on draw order alone. Cell size: nothing in the carve or finish refuses a plot grid whose typical cell leaves the band; it holds because plot_across/row_step are calibrated constants.
sketch: Make every field_channel on a comb map late (or have field_channel default to the late block once one exists), so no channel can precede a plot. For cell size, have fit_field/carve_comb assert the median interior cell area inside the band (research/fields.html 'Plot sizes, pond sizing and acreage from population') and adjust plot_across when a carve leaves it.
later_stage_risk: finish() splices the water blocks; any later stage that emits plot polygons after the late-water anchor would bury channels.
notes: _regen_and_gate no longer runs a check battery (feature 166): it only proves the gen runs within budget and emits a manifest. The two map properties are measured on the SVG. Polder/dike-pond maps are exempt from the cell-size band.

rule: A rolled hamlet must never seat under 85% of its declared households, never land its paddy acreage more than 15% off target, and never strand a farmhouse (baseline_verdict on farmhouses_reach_a_way).
sketch: Seating: after the seven rounds, re-roll (the driver already re-rolls for reach) or widen the rescue until placed >= ceil(0.85*households) and refuse to return short. Acreage: fit_field keeps the closest carve even when no aspect lands within tolerance (fit.py:89-98) - have plan_site grow the canvas/envelope when every aspect saturates. Reach: generate stops after four re-rolls and keeps the least-bad (driver.py:452-485); the owner is the web (ways/serve.py) which should refuse to leave a seated house unserved.
later_stage_risk: Reach depends on stage_web and later lane trims (sweeps, smooth); a later trim can cut the only way to a house.
notes: ACREAGE_SHORT ledgers seeds 45/47 where the fan saturates at every aspect - direct proof fit_field does not guarantee acreage. The driver's re-roll keeps a roll only if it seats no fewer (driver.py:484) but never requires the 0.85 floor.

rule: generate re-rolls a map that strands a farmhouse, forbidding the stranded seats.
notes: Driver re-roll loop on stand-in stages and a faked oracle.

rule: A re-roll that strands more houses is rejected and the first roll kept, finished once.
notes: Driver loop on stand-in stages.

rule: A re-roll resumes at stage_homesteads from an untouched snapshot.
notes: Snapshot/resume pipeline (feature 284).

rule: Two re-rolls from one snapshot are independent copies.
notes: Snapshot pipeline.

rule: The stage profile takes the same snapshot as the plain loop.
notes: Profiling path.

rule: A dike-pond hamlet must never lack its overlay/dike-pond record, 1-3 fry ponds, pig sties, a wet strip on every declared waterward flank, every household seated, or draw a duck pen or a threshing floor (forecourts only).
mechanism: Guarded: fry count is min(3, max(1, round(0.1*n))) (settlement/fields/landuse.py:187); one waterside marsh per declared flank, declared in the same loop (hamletgen/water/polder.py:466-469); forecourt-only yards on a no-rice hamlet (settlement/homestead_parts/yards.py:579-580, skeleton.py:84); no duck-pen code remains. Unguarded: stage_pond_stock may seat zero sties (pondstock.py:95-104 skips every pond whose near-half seats are refused, n_sty is rounded and may be 0); placed==households is not guaranteed (see seating rows).
sketch: stage_pond_stock: when no near-half seat fits, widen to the whole bank before skipping, and guarantee at least one sty when n_sty>=1 (feature 150 A3). Households: as the seating rows.
later_stage_risk: None known for sties (they reserve ground before the web).
notes: Also pins Kuwabata's archetype/pond_layout (pinned-style assertions).

rule: A pinned water_source_position is honored and the stream path draws a stream.
notes: Knob pin + branch coverage of roll_village's stream path.

rule: A pinned knob overrides the roll.
notes: Knob bookkeeping.

rule: A non-connector lane must never turn past 140 degrees, nor make two 50-degree turns within 40 ft of path.
owner: l7r/diagram/hamletgen/ways/serve.py:_serve_stragglers (the footpath router, last placer that emits a folded path); the web's later sweeps (ways/sweeps.py, ways/smooth.py) share it
mechanism: ways/clearance.py:222 (may_write) refuses a rewrite that makes a lane newly bend badly; serve.py:556 and 622 rank candidates by (_fouls, _bends_badly). But serve.py:632-635 DRAWS the least-bad folded path as a last resort when no clean candidate exists, and may_write only forbids making it worse. Also _bends_badly (clearance.py:273-285) tests two 50-degree turns separated by ONE segment <= 40 ft, whereas the test sums a run across several segments - so a kink spread over three short legs passes the placer's predicate and fails the rule.
